description: Compares an existing loan (margin, SBLOC, HELOC, mortgage, personal loan, credit card) with Haven's all-in cost on every term: annual cost, savings, the lowest-cost option and the collateral Haven would need.

balance.description: Outstanding balance of the existing loan, in USD.

collateralValue.description: Market value of the brokerage portfolio that would secure Haven financing, in USD.

currentRatePercent.description: The existing loan's annual interest rate, in percent (e.g. 8.25).

debtType.description: Kind of existing debt: margin, sbloc, heloc, mortgage, personal_loan, credit_card or other.

name: compare_existing_debt
title: Compare with existing debt
